name: jstack-full-team
description: Top-level JStack command that deploys the full 11-role team.

interface.longDescription: Top-level Codex command for full JStack team mode. An inspect-first Adaptive Context Gate resolves material requirements before dispatch, asking at most three questions with recommended defaults. The command then deploys the full 11-role team when available, with deterministic capability assignments, launch evidence, and signed result handoffs.
